senses.definition: Without attention to warnings or indications of bad consequences.
examples: Tatiana knew the meat had passed its expiry date, but she ate it regardless.

senses.definition: Anyway; irrespective of what has just been said.
examples: The proposal may become law, or it may not. Regardless, we will adopt it as a club rule.

quotes.text: Hippolita, ſcarce more alive than her daughter, was regardleſs of every thing but her: but when the tender Iſabella’s care would have likewiſe removed her, while the ſurgeons examined Matilda’s wound, ſhe cried, remove me! never! never! I lived but in her, and will expire with her.

quotes.text: The beloved “oof” sound Roblox players — and gamers regardless of what they play — has become a huge meme in the community.

senses.definition: Taking insufficient regard of; heedless; careless.

quotes.text: Always deceived in fact by his own wishes, and regardless of little besides his own convenience.
quotes.reference: 1815 December (indicated as 1816), [Jane Austen], chapter XV, in Emma: […], volume III, London: […] [Charles Roworth and James Moyes] for John Murray, →OCLC, page 279:

quotes.text: I grew, day by day, more moody, more irritable, more regardless of the feelings of others.
quotes.reference: 1843, Edgar Allan Poe, The Black Cat:

senses.definition: (proscribed) Synonym of regardless of; paying no attention to.
examples: Tatiana ate the cauliflower regardless its colour.
